before_taxonomy.classification_basis: The face-swapped applicant used a false identity to seek paid employment and obtained a remote screening interview, establishing a materially AI-mediated economic deception and a human-facing influence attempt with a consequential screening opportunity. Pindrop detected the face swap before hiring and knowingly permitted a further interview for observation. The sources do not establish a final hiring decision, an applicable blocking threshold that failed, or an identifiable real person whose likeness permission can be assessed. Detection and continued observation must therefore remain distinct from a completed hiring deception.
